name: UI/UX Pro Max Skill
headline: UI/UX Pro Max Skill - Design Intelligence for
short_description: The UI/UX Pro Max Skill offers advanced design intelligence for creating professional user interfaces and experiences across multiple platforms. Use AI to enhance your design process and deliver stunning results effortlessly.
author: nextlevelbuilder

sections.overview:
UI/UX Pro Max Skill is an AI agent skill designed to enhance the design process with advanced design intelligence and system tools. The skill includes 161 product type reasoning rules, 178 color palettes, and support for React Native and other frameworks to streamline multi-platform UI/UX creation. It provides designers and developers with design system assets, visual improvements, and structured guidance for delivering professional interfaces. The skill integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI agents to automate design decisions and accelerate the design workflow. Teams can leverage pre-built design systems and comprehensive color solutions to maintain consistency across digital products.
Designing visually appealing landing pages that convert visitors into customers.
Creating intuitive mobile UI layouts that enhance user engagement and satisfaction.
Developing responsive web applications that provide a seamless experience across devices.
Utilizing AI-driven insights to enhance user experience and optimize design choices.
sections.usage:
```
Design a mobile app interface for [APP_NAME] that targets [TARGET_AUDIENCE]. The app should have [NUMBER] primary screens with a focus on [KEY_FEATURES]. Use a color palette inspired by [COLOR_PALETTE] and ensure the design follows [DESIGN_PRINCIPLES].
```
Copy

```
Based on your request, here's a mobile app interface design for 'FitTrack' targeting fitness enthusiasts. The app includes three primary screens: Dashboard, Workout, and Progress. The Dashboard features a clean, minimalist layout with a dark blue and teal color palette, emphasizing key metrics like steps, calories burned, and active minutes. The Workout screen includes interactive elements for starting, pausing, and customizing workouts, with a focus on intuitive navigation. The Progress screen displays detailed analytics and trends, using a combination of bar graphs and line charts to visualize data over time. The design follows modern design principles, ensuring a seamless user experience across all screens.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot
